title: Degree is additive on tensor products of invertible modules on proper schemes of dimension at most one
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $X$ be a scheme proper over $k$ [def-weil-proper-morphism] of topological Krull dimension at most one [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], and let $\mathcal L,\mathcal M$ be invertible $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-sc-invertible-module]. With tensor product as in [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] and degree $\deg_k(\mathcal F)=\chi(X,\mathcal F)-\chi(X,\mathcal O_X)$ for an invertible module as in [def-pc-degree-line-bundle], one has $\deg_k(\mathcal L\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal M)=\deg_k(\mathcal L)+\deg_k(\mathcal M)$.

from.place: The fibrewise ampleness-to-projectivity argument: positivity on normalized geometric-fibre components is converted to relative ampleness and then to a projective-bundle embedding. Supporting input: the proper integral curve degree criterion (0B5X). In the 0B5X proof this is the tensor-product degree formula used to pass from the degree of a positive tensor power to the degree of the line bundle and to obtain linear Euler-characteristic growth.
